summary: Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is Scotland's busiest airport, located approximately 8 miles (13 km) west of Edinburgh city centre. Originally established as Turnhouse Aerodrome during World War I, it has evolved into a major international gateway serving over 14 million passengers annually and connecting Scotland to destinations across Europe, North America, and beyond.
faqs:
Q: How far is Edinburgh Airport from the city centre?
A: Approximately 8 miles (13 km) west of central Edinburgh, with typical journey times of 30-40 minutes depending on traffic and transport mode.

Q: What public transport options connect the airport to Edinburgh?
A: The Edinburgh Tram runs directly between the airport and York Place in the city centre
